name: ultraview
description: See your app instead of reading its code: an interactive, cited map of a repository for the business and for developers — capabilities, systems, data, flows, saved questions and every change your agent makes. The visual layer over ultraindex. A skills.sh agent skill.

scripts.build: tsup && webindex skill copy && node scripts/build-viewer.mjs
scripts.check:build: tsup && webindex skill copy && node scripts/build-viewer.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- scripts/ultraview.mjs skills/ultraview/scripts/ultraview.mjs skills/ultraview/assets/viewer.html && webindex skill check && webindex skill bundle && webindex skill vendor --check
scripts.verify:engine: webindex skill check && webindex skill vendor --check
scripts.engine:gate: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:build

author: maxgfr
